rows.title: Z-Score Calculator
rows.scope: Standardize one value using a supplied mean and positive standard deviation in the same unit; no tail probability or distribution fit.

rows.title: Confidence Interval Calculator
rows.scope: Two-sided normal interval from a supplied estimate and positive standard error; caller establishes a valid normal approximation. Confidence levels: 80%, 90%, 95%, 98%, 99%. No t interval.

numericalEvidence.scopeLimitation: Uses the immutable rounded critical table; no ideal-quantile coverage or minimal-sample guarantee.

rows.title: Sample Size Calculator
rows.scope: Normal-approximation proportion sample-size planning for 0 < p < 1, absolute fractional margin 0 < E ≤ 1, and the five v1 confidence levels; round upward, maximum 1e9. No finite-population correction or inference guarantee.

numericalEvidence.scopeLimitation: Uses the immutable rounded critical table; no ideal-quantile coverage or minimal-sample guarantee.

rows.title: Probability Calculator
rows.scope: Intersection, union, and complement for two supplied independent event probabilities in [0,1]. Independence is assumed; no conditional/dependent-event model.

rows.title: Permutation Calculator
rows.scope: Ordered selections without replacement from n distinct objects, integer 0 ≤ r ≤ n ≤ 1e9; result must be an exact safe integer. P(n,0)=1. No repeated/indistinguishable objects.

rows.title: Combination Calculator
rows.scope: Unordered selections without replacement from n distinct objects; integer 0 ≤ r ≤ n ≤ 10000. Exact integer result must fit Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

rows.title: Binomial Probability Calculator
rows.scope: Exactly k successes in n independent Bernoulli trials with a common fixed success probability p; integer 0 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 10000, 0 ≤ p ≤ 1. Log-space binary64 approximation; interior positive probabilities that underflow, become subnormal or round to one for n>0 are refused. Degenerate p=0 and p=1 include exact zero and one.

rows.title: Normal Distribution Calculator
rows.scope: Normal model with supplied mean and positive standard deviation in the same units as x. PDF has reciprocal input units; z is dimensionless. CDF and upperTail use the immutable v1 erf approximation, not exact probabilities or a certified error bound. Capture is restricted to |z| ≤ 4 and finite normal positive density and tails; extreme tails are refused.

numericalEvidence.scopeLimitation: Finite grid and transformed-case evidence; no continuous-domain error proof.

limitations: Immutable erf approximation; coefficient provenance and global error bound remain unqualified.

rows.title: Bayes Theorem Calculator
rows.scope: Two exhaustive complementary hypotheses H and not-H. prior=P(H), likelihood=P(E|H), evidenceGivenNot=P(E|not-H), each in [0,1]; evidence probability must be positive. Rounded endpoint posteriors with positive evidence from both hypotheses are refused. Supplied probabilities are assumed applicable to the same population and evidence. Retains joint numerator and total-evidence denominator; no diagnostic or causal inference.

rows.title: Molality Calculator
rows.scope: Molality n/m_solvent from solute amount in mol and positive solvent mass in kg. The denominator is solvent mass, not solution mass. Composition only; no ideal-solution activity or colligative-property prediction.

rows.title: pH Calculator
rows.scope: Concentration-model pH = -log10([H+]/(1 mol/L)), with positive hydrogen-ion concentration in mol/L. Ideal dilute-solution approximation treating concentration as activity; no activity coefficients, ionic-strength correction, acid dissociation solving or temperature-based neutrality classification. Values are not restricted to 0–14.

rows.title: Ideal Gas Law Calculator
rows.scope: Ideal-gas absolute pressure P=nRT/V in atm; amount in mol, strictly positive absolute temperature in K and volume in L. Immutable v1 R=0.082057366080960 L·atm·mol^-1·K^-1. Zero amount represents the vacuum limit. No real-gas, gauge-pressure or Celsius conversion.

rows.title: Gas Density Calculator
rows.scope: Ideal-gas density rho=PM/(RT) in g/L; nonnegative absolute pressure in atm, strictly positive molar mass in g/mol and absolute temperature in K. Immutable v1 R=0.082057366080960 L·atm·mol^-1·K^-1. Zero pressure is the vacuum limit; no real-gas corrections.

rows.title: Percent Composition Calculator
rows.scope: Mass percent =100 componentMass/totalMass using g for both masses. Total includes the component and must be positive; component lies from zero through total. A composition ratio, with no volume-percent or mass/volume-percent interpretation.

rows.title: Solution Concentration Calculator
rows.scope: Mass concentration = solute mass in g / positive final total solution volume in L, not solvent volume. The mass/volume ratio underlying the textbook mass-volume percentage is expressed here in g/L, not percent. Composition only; no activity or ideal-solution thermodynamic correction and no conversion to molarity.

rows.title: Stoichiometry Calculator
rows.scope: Target amount in mol from the ratio of positive coefficients in the same supplied balanced reaction. Coefficients may share a fractional rescaling. Assumes complete stoichiometric conversion of the supplied known amount; no equation balancing, limiting-reactant selection, yield, purity or side-reaction model.

rows.title: Half-Life Calculator
rows.scope: Remaining amount for a closed first-order decay process with a constant positive half-life, no replenishment and nonnegative elapsed time. Initial and remaining amounts share one unit; elapsed time and half-life share one time unit. For positive initial amount, capture requires both the decay factor and remaining amount to be positive normal binary64 values; mathematical decay rounded to zero or subnormal intermediates is refused.

rows.title: Nernst Equation Calculator
rows.scope: Nernst cell potential E = E° - (RT/nF) ln Q for the same balanced redox reaction, with E° applicable at the supplied positive kelvin temperature and a positive safe-integer electron transfer count n. Q is a positive dimensionless activity quotient relative to standard states, with pure solid/liquid activities taken as unity; concentration substitution requires justified ideal behavior. The engine fixes R = 8.31446261815324 J/(mol K) and F = 96485.33212 C/mol; it does not compute activities, temperature corrections to E°, kinetics, overpotential or junction potentials.

rows.title: Beer-Lambert Law Calculator
rows.scope: Decadic absorbance A = εbc using molar absorption coefficient ε in L/(mol cm), optical path b in cm and concentration c in mol/L. Assumes collimated monochromatic radiation, a homogeneous isotropic absorbing medium, and valid linear response at the chosen wavelength; excludes scattering, stray light, concentration-dependent interactions, speciation changes and detector saturation. Zero factor gives zero absorbance within the ideal mathematical model.

rows.title: Titration Calculator
rows.scope: Analyte molar concentration at exact equivalence of the supplied balanced titrant/analyte reaction, using positive stoichiometric coefficients with optional common fractional rescaling. Titrant concentration is in mol/L; titrant and analyte volumes must use the same unit (for example both mL). Assumes quantitative selective reaction, known titrant concentration, and measured volumes; no endpoint/equivalence correction, blank correction, dilution, acid/base speciation or uncertainty model.
